accessToken.title: Access token
accessToken.description: Token NapCat requires for this connection. Falls back to ELAINA_ONEBOT_ACCESS_TOKEN when empty.

actionTimeoutMs.title: Action timeout (ms)
actionTimeoutMs.description: How long one NapCat API call may take before it fails. Defaults to 5000.

adminTitles.title: Admin group titles
adminTitles.description: Group member titles that count as administrators. Reserved for the legacy configuration; the runtime does not read it yet.

adminUsers.title: Admin user ids
adminUsers.description: OneBot user ids allowed to run destructive actions such as group management and raw calls.

botAccountId.title: Bot account id
botAccountId.description: The bot's own account id, used to recognise its own messages. Defaults to elaina-server.

channelId.title: Channel id
channelId.description: Identifier for this channel instance. Incoming events and chat objects are stored under it; defaults to onebot.

deleteGroupFile.title: Allow deleting group files
deleteGroupFile.description: Allow administrators to delete files from NapCat group storage.

maxChars.title: Max characters
maxChars.description: Character budget for one expanded bundle.

maxNodes.title: Max nodes
maxNodes.description: Maximum number of nested messages to expand.

timeoutMs.title: Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long fetching one forwarded bundle may take.

forwardExpand.title: Expand forwarded chats
forwardExpand.description: Download and expand forwarded message bundles before the model sees them. Enable it, or switch it off to keep only the summary node.

groupManage.title: Allow group management
groupManage.description: Allow administrators to run group actions: mute, kick, rename, card, title, and whole-group mute.

host.title: Reverse listen host
host.description: Interface the reverse WebSocket server binds to. Reverse mode only; defaults to 127.0.0.1.

mode.title: Connection mode
mode.description: Forward: Elaina dials NapCat. Reverse: NapCat dials Elaina. Defaults to forward.

pendingGraceMs.title: Pending delivery grace (ms)
pendingGraceMs.description: Grace period in milliseconds before an unconfirmed delivery is reconciled. Defaults to 15000.

port.title: Reverse listen port
port.description: Port the reverse WebSocket server listens on. Reverse mode only; defaults to 3002.

timeoutMs.title: Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long one transcription may take.

pttToText.title: Transcribe voice messages
pttToText.description: Turn voice messages into text when a transcriber is available. Enable it, or switch it off to ignore voice content.

rawActionAllowlist.title: Raw action allowlist
rawActionAllowlist.description: Raw OneBot action names the agent may call through rawAction. Empty disables raw calls entirely.

jitterRatio.title: Jitter ratio
jitterRatio.description: Random spread applied to each delay, between 0 and 1. Defaults to 0.1.

maxDelayMs.title: Max delay (ms)
maxDelayMs.description: Upper bound for the retry delay. Defaults to 30000.

reconnect.title: Reconnect backoff
reconnect.description: Exponential backoff used while NapCat is unreachable.

replyAsQuote.title: Reply with a quote
replyAsQuote.description: Quote the message being answered instead of sending a standalone reply.

selfManage.title: Allow bot account changes
selfManage.description: Allow administrators to change the bot account itself: avatar, profile, long nickname, online status.

sendIntervalMs.title: Delay between chunks (ms)
sendIntervalMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between consecutive reply chunks. Defaults to 400.

splitMaxChars.title: Max characters per chunk
splitMaxChars.description: Maximum characters per reply chunk; longer replies are split. Defaults to 2000.

wsUrl.title: WebSocket URL
wsUrl.description: NapCat forward WebSocket address, for example ws://127.0.0.1:3001. Falls back to ELAINA_ONEBOT_WS_URL when empty.
